svg.aria-label: Two heads side by side. The first is crowded with half-remembered steps: run the migration first, which key for staging, check five dashboards, the PR template, how we debugged this last time. The second head has room for one thing, the actual problem, while the steps sit outside it in a small script that never forgets.
svg.text: every manual step lives in your head until it lives in code
manual: the steps crowd out the problem
